full_details: Phillips stopped the song at the first broken note and would not give Sam a second try. Nobody at the yard named a replacement. Arthur's hooks were still split. At four Heminges called from Aldermanbury, a house full of boys. Sam was by the fire with honey, being kept dumb. Arthur was learning the owl and singing it as a judgment. You said the owl may be a judgment and the cuckoo cannot. The order was Sam if he can, Arthur if he must, and no word to Sam. Heminges asked if the king goes forward. You said he is talking. At night you laid Thursday's sheets face down and shut Daniel. You copied nothing.
one_sentence: Sam croaked at the yard and was stopped, and at four Heminges kept the second boy a secret from him.
title: Stopped Sam's croak at the yard
